{{Top|canon=Hovercab}}
[[File:Taxids.jpg|thumb]]
A '''taxi speeder''',<ref name="SW">[[Star Wars (1977) 48|''Star Wars'' (1977) 48]]</ref> also known as a '''hovertaxi''',<ref name="Lianna">''[[Mission to Lianna]]''</ref> '''hover cab''',<ref name="Darknell">{{StoryCite|story=Interlude at Darkknell|book=Tales from the New Republic}}</ref> '''grav-cab''',<ref name="KT">''[[X-Wing: The Krytos Trap]]''</ref> '''repulsorcab''',<ref name="TC">''[[Republic Commando: True Colors]]''</ref> or '''repulsortaxi'''<ref name="AIR">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref> was the name applied to [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeders]] that functioned as taxis. Unlike their [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] counterparts, [[Air taxi/Legends|air taxis]], taxi speeders operated close to the ground. Some versions were piloted by [[Droid/Legends|droids]].
